class: arithmetic on measured artifact parameters; no circuit is built

benchmark_ii.conclusion: the archived decoder holds one 876-qubit register and at most 15 transient qubits; a two-register design cannot be narrower than 1752, so this width is an algorithm change, not an optimisation of the reference

emitter.what_remains: the width is settled: 891 = 876 array + 12 scale + 3 control, the division-free variant, verified at m=15, m=255 and m=4095. What is still missing is the complete reversible stream: the measured key-equation stage alone is 313,110 Toffolis (0.789x the archive), leaving 20.5 Toffolis per position for Chien, Forney and uncompute

accuracy.conclusion: the bundle is at the gate: any rewrite that perturbs rotation precision fails, so only exactly accuracy-neutral width cuts are admissible

admissible_width_cut.note: the state-prep scratch is exact, so recycling it is accuracy-neutral; the angle circuits are already at the 128 cap

in_tree_angle_family.accuracy_effect: none: the angle words are the same 8-bit table
in_tree_angle_family.conclusion: arity is neutral (k-ary costs k-1 ANDs to decode one of k children, so every arity is rows-1 per circuit); QROAM's optimum at block 63 costs 1,905 Toffolis but needs 2,594 qubits against a 128-qubit cap; inside the cap the best block is 2 at 29,850 Toffolis. The archive's 581 per circuit is 3.42x below the cheapest cap-feasible shape, so the gap is the encoding, not the tuning
